revisions.source: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets appear heavily decayed. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
revisions.target: 这副曾经辉煌的沃瑞钽臂铠如今已严重朽坏。它最初在魔法狩猎中使用，常被用于摧毁奥术类装备，以消除它们对世界的影响。

revisions.source: attempt to destroy all magic effects and sustains on creatures in a radius %d cone (unnatural creatures are additionally dealt %0.2f arcane damage and stunned)
revisions.target: 在半径%d码锥形范围内尝试驱散生物身上的魔法效果和魔法持续技能（至多两项；非自然生物还会额外受到%0.2f奥术伤害并被震慑）

revisions.source: Absorbs all darkness (power %d, based on Willpower and Cunning) within its light radius, increasing its own brightness. (current charge %d).
revisions.target: 在光照范围内吸收所有黑暗（强度 %d，基于意志和灵巧）并增加亮度（当前蓄能：%d）。

revisions.source: This green robe is engraved with icons showing clouds and swirling winds. Its original owner, a powerful mage named Proccala, was often revered for both his great benevolence and his intense power when it proved necessary.
revisions.target: 这件绿色长袍上刻有云朵和旋风的图案。它最初的主人是名叫普偌卡拉的强大法师，人们常因他的仁善，以及他在必要时展现出的强大力量而敬重他。

revisions.source: release a burst of light and dark damage (scales with Magic)
revisions.target: 释放一次光系和暗影伤害爆发（受魔力加成）

revisions.source: These titanic double-helical arrows seem to have been designed more for knocking down towers than for use in regular combat. They'll no doubt make short work of most foes.
revisions.target: 巨大的双螺旋箭，似乎是为推倒高塔而非常规战斗设计。毫无疑问，它们会迅速干掉大多数敌人。

revisions.source: This surreal dagger crackles with the intensity of a vicious storm.
revisions.target: 这柄超现实的匕首噼啪作响，蕴含着狂暴风暴般的强烈力量。

revisions.source:
Reduces all damage by %d%% of current vim or 50%% of the damage, whichever is lower; but at the cost of vim equal to 5%% of the damage blocked. 
Current Bonus: %d
revisions.target:
降低所有伤害相当于%d%%当前活力值的数值，但不超过伤害值的50%%；降低伤害时，消耗相当于被抵消伤害 5%% 的活力值。
当前加成：%d

revisions.source: A cautionary tale tells of the ancient warlock by the name of Caim, who fancied himself daily walks through Goedalath, both to test himself and the harsh demonic wastes. He was careful to never bring anything back with him, lest it provide a beacon for the demons to find him. Unfortunately, over time, his sandals drenched in the soot and ashes of the fearscape and the fire followed his footsteps outside, drawing in the conclusion of his grim fate.
revisions.target: 这是一个警示故事，讲的是有个叫凯姆的古代术士，为了勘查地狱般的恶魔荒原，也为了考验自己，自命不凡地认为可以在恶魔的老巢高达勒斯天天散步。他每次从恶魔位面归来都小心翼翼地不敢带回任何东西，生怕成为恶魔找到他的指引。不幸的是，来回很多次以后，他的草鞋浸满了恶魔空间的烟尘和灰烬。火焰随他的脚步被带到了世间，同时也注定了他悲惨的命运。

revisions.source: Each step you take leaves a burning trail behind you lasting 5 turns that deals %d fire damage (based on Spellpower) to foes who enter it.
revisions.target: 你每踏出一步会在脚下留下一条持续5回合的燃烧痕迹，对进入其中的敌人造成 %d 火焰伤害（基于法术强度）。

revisions.source: This hat's broad brim protects you from biting colds and sudden storms.
revisions.target: 这顶帽子宽阔的帽檐能保护你免受刺骨严寒和突如其来的暴风雨侵袭。

revisions.source: This torque feels tingly to the touch, but seems to enhance your thinking.
revisions.target: 这项圈摸起来让人觉得刺痛，但似乎增强了你的思考。

revisions.source: The blade glows faintly blue, and reflects a sky full of stormy clouds.
revisions.target: 斧刃泛着淡淡的蓝色，反射出了满天的乌云。

revisions.source: This mindstar glows with a bright warm light, but seems somehow incomplete.
revisions.target: 这个灵晶散发着明亮而温暖的光芒，但似乎有点残缺。

revisions.source: Keep a firm grip on it. These things will dig themselves right back into the ground if you drop them.
revisions.target: 牢牢地抓住它，如果你不小心把它掉在地上，它会立刻挖地逃走。
